## Overview

This analysis leverages **over 100,000 play-by-play observations** from NCAA Division I Women's Volleyball matches. 

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(scales)

# Download NCAA Women's Volleyball Play-by-Play Data (100k+ rows)
pbp_url <- "[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JeffreyRStevens/ncaavolleyballr/main/inst/extdata/pbp_wvb_d1_2023.csv](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JeffreyRStevens/ncaavolleyballr/main/inst/extdata/pbp_wvb_d1_2023.csv)"
vball_data <- read_csv(pbp_url)
...
...
#| label: volleyball-graphic
#| fig-width: 9
#| fig-height: 5.5
#| fig-cap: "Distribution of shot outcomes across top division teams based on 100k+ play-by-play contacts."

# Filter for attack/kill/error outcomes
attack_data <- vball_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(action_type)) %>%
  count(team_name, action_type) %>%
  group_by(team_name) %>%
  filter(sum(n) > 500) %>% # Keep top active teams
  slice_max(n, n = 15)

ggplot(attack_data, aes(x = reorder(team_name, n), y = n, fill = action_type)) +
  geom_col(position = "stack", width = 0.7) +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#FF85A1", "#FBB1BD", "#B5E2FA", "#03045E", "#70D6FF")) +
  labs(
    title = "Shot Action Counts Across Top Teams",
    subtitle = paste("Based on", comma(nrow(vball_data)), "NCAA play-by-play events"),
    x = "Team Name",
    y = "Total Recorded Actions",
    fill = "Action Type",
    caption = "Data: ncaavolleyballr package"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16, color = "#2B2D42"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#8D99AE", margin = margin(b = 10)),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FAFAFA", color = NA)
  ---
